subject: Next steps: pricing path & finance gatekeepers
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@brighthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: pricing path & finance gatekeepers

Hey Sam — great conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on scope and stakeholders: 

- Summary: BrightHealth is evaluating Redwood for clinical-note generation and patient messaging; expected steady-state usage ~4–6M tokens/mo with initial spike in POC months.
- Cost target you mentioned: aim for a blended $/1M tokens in the ~$900–$1,200 range depending on SLA and retention.
- Important internal approvers you called out: Angela Park (economic buyer / VP Data) and Liam O'Connor (finance approver). Procurement loop: procurement@brighthealth.com.

My ask from you: please confirm (1) that Angela will be the signatory for commercial approval and (2) whether finance expects a separate purchase order or SOW + invoice flow. Once confirmed, I’ll send a one-page price breakdown (by model and quantization profile) and a brief procurement checklist for your team + a 1-week timeline for pricing finalization.

Attachments: I’ll follow up momentarily with a draft price sheet and procurement checklist.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll share the pricing spreadsheet and procurement checklist by EOD today.
2) You confirm Angela + Liam as the approvers (or correct names).
3) We tentatively schedule a 30-min procurement sync (this week) to cover PO fields and any SOC2 evidence requests.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

[Attachment stub: Redwood-1M-token-pricing.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Sam Patel <sam@brighthealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 17:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: pricing path & finance gatekeepers

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few points from our side: 

- Budget band: leadership is comfortable with an annual run-rate in the $75k–$120k range initially for the POC/early rollout, with potential to scale if latency and integration look good. That maps to roughly 4–6M tokens/mo as we discussed.
- Target unit economics: our procurement lead asked if we can hit a target closer to $950/1M tokens for committed volumes; $1,200 would be ok only if there are clear SLA guarantees and premium support.
- Stakeholders: Angela Park is the economic buyer and will own the final decision. Liam O'Connor (Finance Director) must sign off on invoices/POs. Procurement contact is procurement@brighthealth.com.

Request: Please include an explicit line item showing effective $/1M tokens at (a) no-commit/ondemand, (b) 6M tokens/month commit, and (c) 12M tokens/month commit, plus any discounts tied to term. Also include a brief note on what triggers a price rollback/rollback protection.

We can do the procurement sync Thu 9/9 at 11:00 PT if that works — I’ll loop Angela and Liam after you share the pricing.

—Sam
Sam Patel
Sr. Product Manager, BrightHealth
sam@brighthealth.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@brighthealth.com>, Angela Park <angela.park@brighthealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brighthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing sheet + procurement sync (Thu 9/9) — pre-read attached

Hi Sam / Angela / Liam — looping you in as requested. Attaching a concise pricing spreadsheet and a short procurement checklist to make the Thu sync efficient. Highlights up front: 

- Pricing framing (high level):
  • On-demand (no commit): $1,500 / 1M tokens
  • 6M/mo commit: $1,050 / 1M tokens (effective)
  • 12M/mo commit: $880 / 1M tokens (effective)
  These are starting points; we can compress tiers depending on term length and SLA.

- Volume assumptions: first 3 months may see 8–10M tokens/mo due to onboarding; steady-state expected 4–6M tokens/mo.
- SLA & premium support: we can provide a 99.9% inference availability SLA and a named-respondent support line on the 12M/commit tier.

Attachments included: 1) Redwood-1M-token-pricing.xlsx — per-tier breakdown and sample invoice; 2) Redwood-procurement-checklist.docx — PO fields, SOC2 evidence link, and billing contact.

Requested confirmations from BrightHealth: 
1) Is Angela the commercial signatory (yes/no)?
2) Does finance prefer PO-first or SOW + invoice?
3) Any hard constraints on payment term (Net30/Net45)?

I’ve penciled Thu 9/9 11:00 PT for a 30-min procurement sync. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and the DocuSign link for a preliminary SOW we can update post-sync.

Thanks — Jonas

[Attachment stubs: Redwood-1M-token-pricing.xlsx (xlsx), Redwood-procurement-checklist.docx (docx)]

From: Sam Patel <sam@brighthealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Angela Park <angela.park@brighthealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@brighthealth.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing sheet + procurement sync (Thu 9/9) — pre-read attached

Jonas / team — quick confirmations ahead of the sync: 

- Angela confirmed: yes, she is the economic buyer and will sign the commercial commitment.
- Liam confirmed: finance will sign the PO; preferred flow is PO -> SOW + invoice (Net30). Liam asked that you include our PO number field and remit-to address on the invoice template in the checklist.
- Budget band: Angela is comfortable starting at the mid-point of your 6M tier (approx $1,050 / 1M) for the POC term; we’ll re-evaluate after 90 days. If we hit response time targets in the POC, we’ll look to move to the 12M tier.

Action items for Redwood before Thu sync: 
1) Please add an explicit row in the pricing sheet that shows the final effective monthly invoice at 6M tokens/month (with the discount applied) and the expected monthly cost for the POC.
2) Include a single-line SLA summary we can paste into our internal procurement form.
3) Add invoice sample with PO field and remit-to address.

I’ll send a calendar accept shortly. Looking forward to the sync.

—Sam
